description_en: Pushes a property value. After the push, all clients that subscribe to the corresponding property update the in-memory value within one second and invoke the setter method associated with the property
description_zh: 推送后所有订阅对应属性的客户端都会在一秒内更新内存值，并回调属性对应的 setter 方法
kebab_example: aliyun sofa push-ms-config-data --attribute-id 1 --cells Cell1,Cell2 --data 12 --instance-id abcdEFGH1234 --operator wang.li --region cn-hangzhou
name: PushMsConfigData
